card.name: Verbs of giving treatment in studies
card.fires_on: Verbs and small words that say how study subjects were given a treatment, such as received, given, administered, consumed, randomized to. Seen in descriptions of animal or human trials, just before the treatment is named.

modes.label: Subjects received treatment
modes.description: A verb like received, given or administered after the study subjects (rats, mice, patients) and before the agent.
modes.example: In the study, normal mice were<< given>> sorafenib

modes.label: Assignment wording
modes.description: Small words such as to, for or with in randomization or duration phrases, leading into the treatment arm.
modes.example: a population of 2,947 hysterectomized women 65 to 79 years of age was randomized<< to>> daily CE (0.625
